_comment: Model presets the desktop app offers at Mu2e in addition to ../site/models.json (the web UI's list on the gpvms): gateways a laptop can reach that the gpvm install does not offer. Same format as that file's presets. connect.py appends them; a preset whose baseUrl is already in the site's list is left out.
relay_comment: Fermilab's https model addresses that --mode ssh reaches through the ssh connection, each with the local port its relay listens on (the forwarded port is that plus 100). Keep a port once given: it is part of the address the app saves.

presets.name: NRP (National Research Platform)
presets.note: Open models (glm-5, gpt-oss, qwen3, gemma, kimi, deepseek) served by the NRP; needs an NRP API key.

presets.name: AmSC-MAG
presets.note: American Science Cloud model gateway (Genesis); needs an AmSC-MAG API key.
